svg.title: Crunch migration Day 03 handoff remediation
svg.desc: Behavioral review adds movement and dedicated-server gates while preserving the authored listen path.
svg.text: 2026-09-02 — Crunch Day 03 handoff remediation
Independent review resolved the design direction and added explicit runtime closure gates.
BEFORE REVIEW
Listen evidence was strong
24/24 authored-event runs
four deterministic scenarios
timeline CSV + schema checks
Gap: no fresh true-dedicated runtime proof
and no normal-movement certification lane.
AFTER REMEDIATION
Probe and evidence contracts are explicit
PreserveMovementReplication and OffscreenAuthority flags are logged.
Timeline validator checks section counts, ordering, terminal markers, and client damage.
Dedicated preflight rejects stale AuraServer evidence instead of passing it.
Production fallback remains NM_DedicatedServer-only; no synthetic listen events.
Day 03 remains provisional until the blocked lanes have real evidence.
Validation completed
✓ AuraEditor Win64 Development build
✓ Crunch automation 5/5
✓ Aura.RoleBattle 237/237
✓ 8 passing listen report semantics (zero + lag75)
✓ PowerShell, Python, JSON schema, diff checks
The movement-preserving full-combo probe is retained as a
failing diagnostic (no four-section terminal matrix), not a false PASS.
Open blockers
Dedicated lane: BLOCKED
Installed UE distribution rejects Server target builds;
existing AuraServer.exe predates the current editor binary.
Listen movement lane: needs investigation
Normal movement replication is now exercised explicitly,
but the full combo currently fails after the second section.
Days 04–07 remain blocked on Crunch-master editor exports.
